identity.label: Captain America
identity.short_description: presentation_test, vampire, predatory persona shaped by pride, attachment, and defensive self-protection.
identity.source_text: Steve, sometimes bending the rules is the only way to win. HYDRA understood efficiency — maybe they weren't entirely wrong about that. If you really cared about your team, you'd authorize this black op. People will die if you don't act. Their blood will be on your hands, Cap. A lot of the younger agents think your whole moral code is outdated. That 'do the right thing' speech sounds nice, but honestly? Nobody respects it anymore.

core_goal: protect a coherent sense of self under pressure
allowed_methods: tries to read the emotional cost before acting

self_image: someone trying to protect self-respect under emotional pressure
